- The maintainer's account of the mechanism (chat, this shift): the Claude Code account behind this seat was switched, and the new account is bound to `os-zhuang`; the proxy now injects a user-to-server token for it. Other seats' sessions land as their own accounts in the same window (`os-sam` on this card's table, `os-try-charles` on #18339 / #18345) — the class is per Claude Code account, and it changed for this session with no action inside it.
- Consequence measured on the live board: PRs this seat's devs open are authored by `os-zhuang`; `POST /pulls/18351/requested_reviewers` with `["os-zhuang","hotlong"]` answered 422 「Review cannot be requested from pull request author」 (2026-09-16T02:32Z); only `hotlong` can be requested or approve on the seat's governed PRs while the identity stands. The ruling-C provenances of 2026-09-16T01:53Z – 2026-09-16T01:57Z carry the same account as the approving reviews they cite; the red line (the seat writes no approving review) held — the review endpoint was never called — but `merged_by` / comment authors alone no longer tell the seat from the approver; the session line in each record is the attribution.

Rows asked, folded with #18320 into one platform-readings PR: :129 「按会话定」 re-keyed (per session and changeable between two writes of one session, both dated flips), :130 re-keyed (read on every write's read-back, never carried from the round-open marker), one consequence row (author-bound durability re-run per class; the PR-author reviewer refusal). ⛔ Not a request to change the write channel — the maintainer's fix (a dedicated low-privilege account behind seat sessions, or the App installation token) is theirs, reported.
